name: Approach Masjid
summary: A low mosque arcade and one square minaret open onto a broad, diagonal approach.
why: The mosque has one horizontal foundation at y=65. Its raised entrance is centered at x=66; the path begins within that opening, shares both door jambs, then widens diagonally into the foreground. The left-hand minaret and attached balcony counterbalance the path.
risk: The flat-roof courtyard is less conventional than a domed mosque. The paired arcade openings simplify at 24px, while the large entrance remains readable.
sub1: The entrance opens directly into a broad diagonal path
sub2: One square minaret balances a stepped arcade
theme: A diagonal approach to the mosque courtyard
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctive geometric mosque whose composition remains coherent without color.
